newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatia appoints three-member securities watchdog.
newsitem.headline: Croatia appoints three-member securities watchdog.

text.p: Croatia's parliament, the Sabor, named three commissioners of a planned five-member securities watchdog at the weekend, local media reported on Monday.

Almost seven months since the body should have been in place in line with the securities law, the Sabor appointed to it Assistant Finance Minister Ivica Smiljan for a period of six years and another ministry official, Ivo Sulenta, for four years.

The daily Vjesnik said Ante Gasparovic, a securities expert formerly of Zagrebacka Banka, was also appointed for four years. It said the posts of two remaining commissioners, each for a period of two years, would be advertised later.
